subject.title: fix(msteams): normalize inbound mentions and forwards

question: Should this PR remain blocked until a redacted current-head Microsoft Teams tenant transcript or diagnostic output directly demonstrates the new normalization behavior?
rationale: The supplied proof confirms test fixtures and aggregate path activity but explicitly lacks a current-head live Teams capture; the correct merge gate depends on maintainer acceptance of that evidence threshold.

options.title: Require live Teams proof

options.title: Accept fixture and telemetry evidence
